My name is Tushar Dhanorkar, a Master of Business Analytics student at Monash University in Melbourne. I'm interested in turning data into clear stories that help people make decisions, using R, Python and Quarto.

Before moving to Australia, I worked for about two years as a consultant and Project Manager in Pune, India. That work taught me how much of analytics is explaining findings to people who don't want technical detail. I also hold a B.Tech and a PG-DAC diploma in computing.

This site collects my data stories. The first post turns a university assignment on hospital infections into a plain-language article for general readers.
